cohort: 73 pregnant women who visited the prenatal OPD at SKMCH, Muzaffarpur, Bihar from April 2022 to September 2022.
finding: Subclinical hypothyroidism (SCH) in pregnant women was associated with increased incidences of elevated blood pressure and low birth weight in infants.
birth_weight: Low birth weight was an outcome measured, but the specific weight range was not defined in the abstract
